description: Kleros Skills hosts Markdown knowledge packs for AI agents about using the Kleros decentralized justice ecosystem. The site publishes skill documents such as the top-level `SKILL.md` and per-skill files under paths like `/kleros-ipfs-upload/SKILL.md`.
summary: Publicly accessible skill-document endpoints at `https://skills.kleros.io/<skill>/SKILL.md`; no same-domain REST/GraphQL/MCP/CLI integration surface beyond these static skill files was documented.
